title: Twist E23: Mixed extension helpers and partial-relation elimination
status_note: Proposed E23; not started. Certified projectors, exact helper identities, replayable graph elimination and full counters are missing. A separate runnable protocol and source/checker pins are required.
blocked_on: note:Certified projectors, exact helper identities, replayable graph elimination and full counters are missing.
question: Can general extension-point helpers reduce collection cost after every helper is eliminated, compared with the identical rational partial-relation graph?
decision_value: A heldout complete-cost improvement supports this collector. A larger partial graph with unchanged useful span does not. Pure-twist-only output must agree with the E29 separation certificate.

resources.notes: Proposed pilot: one CPU, 4 GiB; cap each cell at 2^20 group operations, 2^16 stored partial rows and 120 seconds. Record whichever cap fires and the unresolved target span. Full resources remain unestimated. The nominal disk field is not an estimate; calibrate and freeze it before readiness.

outputs.result_schema: Not frozen; required evidence fields are in the linked design. No result exists.
